meaning: Not draining properly: the drain filter is blocked.
causes: Loose pump cover under the filter
Plug still in the garbage disposal's dishwasher drain connection
diySteps: Check the inlet hose and make sure it is not kinked or damaged
Remove the filter to reveal the pump cover at the bottom of the dishwasher and make sure the cover is not loose (see your owner's manual if you cannot find it)
If the drain hose goes to a garbage disposal's dishwasher drain connection, make sure the plug has been removed from that connection
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If E24 remains after these checks, contact Bosch Customer Support.
sourceTitle: Bosch Dishwasher Error Codes: Troubleshooting Guide (Bosch)
